justification: Both are stone carvings in shallow relief that include a human/anthropomorphic presence, circular disc motifs and a horizontal band-like division, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a flat, wide frieze with a processional row of figures and an animal reading left-to-right beneath a rosette border, whereas B is a massive freestanding three-dimensional block with a single head-and-torso form bearing sparse incised symbols on its back; the rendering, scale and format are wholly different.
